title: Python Voice Bot
description: Single-file Python script that takes an Indic audio file, transcribes it via Saarika, asks Sarvam-M for a reply, and synthesizes the reply with Bulbul. The minimal end-to-end voice agent loop.

options.PROJECT_NAME: Project name. Defaults to the target directory name.
options.REPLY_LANGUAGE: BCP-47 code for the reply audio. Default: hi-IN.
options.DEFAULT_SPEAKER: Bulbul v3 speaker id. Default: priya.
